mcp_tools.name: vendor_evaluation_three_way_match_pack
mcp_tools.title: Vendor evaluation three way match pack
mcp_tools.description: Submits a vendor evaluation and three-way match record (spec and sourcing declarations, evaluation setup, declared vendor rows and declared criteria rows, contract and terms declarations, purchase-order discipline declarations, three-way match declarations, declared purchase-order, receipt and invoice line rows, vendor-record declarations, red lines) and returns a deterministic VENDOR_EVALUATION_AND_MATCH_SOUND / VENDOR_EVALUATION_AND_MATCH_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across seven sections, including exact recomputation of weighted vendor totals, per-line totals, cross-document quantity and unit-price matching and both grand totals over the declared rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record only; it contacts no vendor, approves no payment and gives no procurement advice.

inputSchema.description: The vendor evaluation three way match pack manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).
